title: research-gym
tagline: Reps until AI research and engineering feel ordinary.

book.title: Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)
book.author: Sebastian Raschka

phases.name: Onboarding
phases.blurb: Open a pull request, get it reviewed, get it merged. Nothing else.

phases.name: Fundamentals
phases.blurb: Object-oriented Python, taught entirely by building a neural network out of NumPy.

phases.name: PyTorch and experiments
phases.blurb: The same model in a real framework, then the habits that make a result trustworthy.

phases.name: An LLM from scratch
phases.blurb: Raschka's book, chapter by chapter: tokenizer, attention, GPT, pretraining, fine-tuning.

phases.name: Research craft
phases.blurb: Reproduce something, evaluate it honestly, write it up, then push past the book.

modules.title: Onboarding
modules.summary: Introduce yourself in a pull request and watch the whole loop run once.

modules.title: OOP refresher
modules.summary: Build Layer, Linear, ReLU and Sequential in NumPy. Forward pass only.

modules.title: Autograd from scratch
modules.summary: A scalar Value that remembers how it was made, and a backward() that walks it.

modules.title: The training loop
modules.summary: Dataset, DataLoader, SGD and Trainer. Fit an MLP to two moons and watch the loss fall.

modules.title: Port it to PyTorch
modules.summary: The same MLP as an nn.Module. The check asserts it matches your module 03 result.

modules.title: Experiments you can trust
modules.summary: A config file, a seeded run directory, a metrics.json, a results table and one ablation.

modules.title: Tokenizer and embeddings
modules.summary: Byte-pair encoding, a vocabulary, and the embedding table it feeds.

modules.title: Attention
modules.summary: Self-attention, then causal masking, then multiple heads.

modules.title: A GPT, assembled
modules.summary: Blocks, residuals, LayerNorm and a head. Your module 01 Sequential, grown up.

modules.title: Pretraining
modules.summary: A real training loop on real text, with checkpoints and sampling.

modules.title: Fine-tuning to classify
modules.summary: Swap the head, freeze what you can, and beat a baseline you chose in advance.

modules.title: Instruction tuning
modules.summary: Format, train, and then judge the output without fooling yourself.

modules.title: Reproduce a result
modules.summary: Pick a small published result. Get within error bars. Document every place you could not.
teaches: reading a paper for its method

modules.title: Evaluation and error analysis
modules.summary: Baselines, ablations, and fifty failure cases read by hand. Ends in a short written report.

modules.title: Post-training
modules.summary: LoRA, then DPO, then GRPO. The first one you will implement; the others you will run and read.
